components.name: Badge
components.summary: Status badges label the state of a product, order or transaction.

components.name: BarChart
components.summary: Bar charts compare amounts across categories or periods, such as monthly revenue against last year or units sold per product.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Buttons trigger actions; one primary (gold) button per view marks the main action.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Cards group related content on the page; the KPI card shows one dashboard metric.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: Chips are compact pill choices: one from a short set (currency, period) or several as filters.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Dialogs focus the user on one action or confirmation.

components.name: DonutChart
components.summary: The donut chart shows how one total splits into a few parts, such as this month's sales by category or payment methods used.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: Icon buttons run a single action shown by an icon alone: round for quick actions and shortcuts, plain for toolbars and the top bar.

components.name: ImageGallery
components.summary: A fixed 4:3 main photo with a full-image fit, square cover-filled thumbnails, clear selection styling, and separate select and remove actions.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Text inputs collect a single value; always with a visible label.

components.name: LineChart
components.summary: Line charts show change over time: daily sales, stock level across weeks, sales by channel.

components.name: NotificationPanel
components.summary: The notification panel is the popover that opens from the bell in the top bar.

components.name: Selector
components.summary: The Selector picks one option from a small set of visual tiles, such as the payment method at checkout or the type of stock movement.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: The persistent, collapsible left sidebar holds the logo, primary navigation, and the signed-in user with a link to Settings.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Tables list products, movements and transactions for scanning and comparison.

components.name: TopBar
components.summary: The top bar holds search, four shortcut buttons, then the theme toggle and notifications, in three groups split by dividers.
